notes: Verify material test certificate and heat number
No decarburization, deep scale or surface cracking
Do not substitute C45 or EN8

geometrical_tolerances.note: Confirm exact type (runout, parallelism) with designer before production release

heat_treatment.process: Case hardened and tempered (Einsatzgehärtet und angelassen)
heat_treatment.reason: No carburizing furnace in equipment list
process_requirements: Suitable fixture to reduce gear and bore distortion
Quench method appropriate for small gears
Separate and protect parts to avoid tooth-to-tooth impact
Avoid aggressive shot blasting of tooth flanks
certifications_required: Microhardness traverse or witness coupon for CHD verification

process_sequence.name: Material Procurement
process_sequence.description: Procure certified 16MnCrS5 round bar (Ø40 or Ø42 mm)
checks: Material test certificate and heat number
No decarburization, scale or surface cracking

process_sequence.name: Saw Cutting
notes: Leave allowance for facing and grinding
No accuracy requirement on saw-cut face

process_sequence.name: Soft Turning — First Setup
operations: Finish-turn pre-heat-treatment bore (leave grinding allowance 0.05–0.10 mm on diameter)
Turn outside gear blank diameter to process target ~Ø37.25 mm
notes: Do not finish bore to N6 before heat treatment
Machine OD and bore in same or accurately related setup for concentricity

process_sequence.name: Soft Turning — Second Setup
process_sequence.fixture: Precision expanding mandrel or soft jaws on previously machined diameter
operations: Bring width to pre-heat-treatment dimension (~22.10–22.20 mm)

process_sequence.name: Gear Hobbing
process_sequence.reason: No gear hobbing or shaping machine in equipment list
process_sequence.hob_requirement: Module 0.85 hob only — no general-purpose form cutter
pre_ht_wk_trial_procedure: Heat treat using intended production cycle
Record Wk and gear errors after heat treatment

process_sequence.name: Tooth-End Chamfering and Deburring
process_sequence.preferred: Combine with hobbing at gear vendor
checks: No rolled burrs on flanks or root fillets
Chamfer depth survives planned face-grinding allowance removal

process_sequence.name: Pre-Heat-Treatment Inspection
items: Gear span over 5 teeth — record Wk

process_sequence.name: Post-Heat-Treatment Face Grinding
sequence: Place datum A on clean precision fixture or magnetic-chuck support

process_sequence.name: Final Bore Grinding or Honing
process_sequence.machine: Cylindrical grinding machine with internal attachment
process_sequence.fixture_recommendation: Locate from gear pitch circle or accurately referenced tooth fixture
post_grinding_checks: Check at front, centre and rear of bore
Check in at least two directions at each position
Remove minimum material to preserve carburized layer

process_sequence.name: Final Deburring and Cleaning
prohibited: Uncontrolled hand grinding on tooth flanks
process_sequence.post_clean: Apply temporary rust-preventive oil after final inspection

Subcontract — preferably combined with hobbing at gear vendor
Subcontract — carburizing furnace not in equipment list

Cylindrical grinder (ID attachment required); else subcontract

dimensional.method: Air gauge, calibrated bore gauge or internal comparator
Precision mandrel, surface plate and dial indicator
Gear measuring machine or optical method
Bore gauge at multiple axial and angular positions

gear.note: Span micrometer alone does NOT prove ISO 1328 grade 9. Full gear measurement on gear measuring centre required.

drawing_clarifications.description: Confirm whether hardness and CHD apply only to gear teeth or also to bore and faces. Affects grinding allowance and whether bore may be masked during carburizing.
Drawing shows theoretical Ø37.365 mm but also explicit limits Ø37.201–37.309 mm. Production should use explicit limits — confirm with designer.
Theoretical Ø33.54 mm shown alongside limits Ø33.376–33.484 mm. Confirm which governs for production acceptance.
No tolerance specified for pitch-circle runout relative to Ø21 bore. Functionally critical for a planet gear — must be confirmed.
Runout-type symbol references datum A (end face). Confirm exact type (runout, parallelism or other) and which surface is controlled.
